{{< include /_macros.qmd >}}

Informal posts are just prose. You can still write inline math like $\Spec \bZ$ or $\mu_p \subset \Gm$, and display math:
$$
0 \to \mu_p \to \Gm \xrightarrow{\;p\;} \Gm \to 0 \quad \text{(exact on the fppf site)}.
$$

*Italics*, **bold**, lists, links and footnotes[^1] all work as usual.

[^1]: Like this one.
